game.title: Kancha (Marbles)
game.description: A classic childhood game played with colorful glass marbles, where players use their shooter marble to knock opponents' marbles out of a circle.
howToPlay: Step 1: Draw a circle on flat ground.
Step 2: Each player places several marbles inside the circle.
Step 3: Players take turns shooting their shooter marble from outside the circle.
Step 4: Flick the shooter with thumb to knock marbles out.
Step 5: Keep any marbles knocked out of the circle.
Step 6: If shooter stays inside, player continues; if not, turn passes.
Step 7: Game continues until all marbles are cleared.
Step 8: Player with most marbles collected wins.
Step 9: Special marbles are prized and traded.
Step 10: Advanced techniques include backspin and curve shots.
